ayahs.1: Qaaf! Bahut badi shaan wale is Quran ki qasam hai.
ayahs.2: Balke unhein taajjub maloom hua ke un ke paas unhi mein se ek aagaah karne wala aaya to kaafiron ne kaha ke yeh ek ajeeb cheez hai.
ayahs.3: Kya jab hum mar kar mitti ho jaayenge. Phir yeh waapsi door (az-aql) hai.
ayahs.4: Zameen jo kuchh un se ghataati hai woh hamein maloom hai aur hamare paas sab yaad rakhne wali kitaab hai.
ayahs.5: Balke unhon ne sachchi baat ko jhoot kaha hai jabke woh un ke paas pahunch chuki pas woh ek uljhaao mein pad gaye hain.
ayahs.6: Kya unhon ne aasman ko apne oopar nahin dekha? Ke hum ne ise kis tarah banaaya hai aur zeenat di hai is mein koi shigaaf nahin.
ayahs.7: Aur zameen ko hum ne bichha diya aur is mein hum ne pahaad daal diye hain aur is mein hum ne qism qism ki khushnuma cheezen uga di hain.
ayahs.8: Taake har ruju karne wale bande ke liye beenaai aur daanaai ka zariya ho.
ayahs.9: Aur hum ne aasman se ba-barkat paani barsaaya aur is se baaghaat aur katne wale khet ke ghalle paida kiye.
ayahs.10: Aur khajooron ke buland-o-baala darakht jin ke khoshe teh-ba-teh hain.
ayahs.11: Bandon ki rozi ke liye aur hum ne paani se murda shehar ko zinda kar diya. Isi tarah (qabron se) nikalna hai.
ayahs.12: Un se pehle Nooh ki qaum ne aur Ras waalon ne aur Samood ne.
ayahs.13: Aur Aad ne Firaun ne aur baradaran-e-Loot ne.
ayahs.14: Aur Aika walon ne Tubba ki qaum ne bhi takzeeb ki thi. Sab ne Paighambaron ko jhutlaaya pas mera waada-e-azaab un par saadiq aa gaya.
ayahs.15: Kya hum pehli baar ke paida karne se thak gaye? Balke yeh log nayi paidaish ki taraf se shak mein hain.
ayahs.16: Hum ne insaan ko paida kiya hai aur us ke dil mein jo khayalaat uthte hain un se hum waaqif hain aur hum us ki rag-e-jaan se bhi zyada us se qareeb hain.
ayahs.17: Jis waqt do lene waale jaa lete hain ek daayen taraf aur ek baayen taraf baitha hua.
ayahs.18: (Insaan) munh se koi lafz nikaal nahin paata magar ke us ke paas nigehbaan taiyaar hai.
ayahs.19: Aur maut ki be-hoshi haq le kar aa pahunchi, yehi hai jis se tu bidakta phirta tha.
ayahs.20: Aur Soor phoonk diya jaayega. Waada-e-azaab ka din yehi hai.
ayahs.21: Aur har shakhs is tarah aayega ke us ke saath ek laane wala hoga aur ek gawaahi dene wala.
ayahs.22: Yaqeenan tu is se ghaflat mein tha lekin hum ne tere saamne se parda hata diya pas aaj teri nigah bahut tez hai.
ayahs.23: Is ka hum-nasheen (farishta) kahega yeh haazir hai jo ke mere paas tha.
ayahs.24: Daal do jahannam mein har kaafir sarkash ko.
ayahs.25: Jo nek kaam se rokne wala hadd se guzar jaane wala aur shak karne wala tha.
ayahs.26: Jis ne Allah ke saath doosra mabood bana liya tha pas ise sakht azaab mein daal do.
ayahs.27: Is ka hum-nasheen (shaitaan) kahega ae hamare Rabb! Main ne ise gumraah nahin kiya tha balke yeh khud hi door-daraaz ki gumraahi mein tha.
ayahs.28: Haq Taala farmaayega bas mere saamne jhagadne ki baat mat karo main to pehle hi tumhari taraf waeed (waada-e-azaab) bhej chuka tha.
ayahs.29: Mere haan baat badalti nahin aur na main apne bandon par zara bhi zulm karne wala hoon.
ayahs.30: Jis din hum dozakh se poochhenge kya tu bhar chuki? Woh jawab degi kya kuchh aur zyada bhi hai?
ayahs.31: Aur jannat parhezgaron ke liye bilkul qareeb kar di jaayegi zara bhi door na hogi.
ayahs.32: Yeh hai jis ka tum se waada kiya jaata tha har us shakhs ke liye jo ruju karne wala aur paabandi karne wala ho.
ayahs.33: Jo Rahman ka ghaibana khauf rakhta ho aur tawajju wala dil laaya ho.
ayahs.34: Tum is jannat mein salaamati ke saath daakhil ho jaao. Yeh hamesha rehne ka din hai.
ayahs.35: Yeh wahaan jo chaahen unhein milega (balke) hamare paas aur bhi zyada hai.
ayahs.36: Aur un se pehle bhi hum bahut si ummaton ko halaak kar chuke hain jo un se taaqat mein bahut zyada thin woh shehron mein dhoondhte hi reh gaye, ke koi bhaagne ka thikaana hai?
ayahs.37: Is mein har sahib-e-dil ke liye ibrat hai aur is ke liye jo dil se mutawajjeh ho kar kaan lagaaye aur woh haazir ho.
ayahs.38: Yaqeenan hum ne aasmanon aur zameen aur jo kuchh is ke darmiyan hai sab ko (sirf) chhe din mein paida kar diya aur hamein takaan ne chhua tak nahin.
ayahs.39: Pas yeh jo kuchh kehte hain aap is par sabr karen aur apne Rabb ki tasbeeh tareef ke saath bayaan karen sooraj nikalne se pehle bhi aur sooraj ghuroob hone se pehle bhi.
ayahs.40: Aur raat ke waqt bhi tasbeeh karen aur namaz ke baad bhi.
ayahs.41: Aur sun rakhen ke jis din ek pukaarne wala qareeb hi ki jagah se pukaarega.
ayahs.42: Jis roz is tund-o-tez cheekh ko yaqeen ke saath sun lenge, yeh din hoga nikalne ka.
ayahs.43: Hum hi jilaate hain aur hum hi maarte hain aur hamari hi taraf laut phir kar aana hai.
ayahs.44: Jis din zameen phat jaayegi aur yeh daudte hue (nikal padenge) yeh jama kar lena hum par bahut hi aasaan hai.
ayahs.45: Yeh jo kuchh keh rahe hain hum bakhoobi jaante hain aur aap un par jabr karne wale nahin, to aap Quran ke zariye unhein samjhaate rahen jo mere waeed (daraane ke waadon) se darte hain.
